_meta.purpose: One curated sentence per mission, shown on the closeup HUD card as the 'FIELD NOTE'. Keyed by mission slug. Slug is the mission name lower-cased with non-alnum runs collapsed to dashes (e.g. 'Brazil São Paulo South Mission' → 'brazil-sao-paulo-south-mission'). Sync will silently render a missing fact as 'no fact yet'; add an entry below to populate the kiosk on the next deploy.

example.brazil-sao-paulo-south-mission: Headquartered in the largest city in the Southern Hemisphere.
